See the month. See if the week moved.
text.The month shows each session in its own: Every session keeps its color, so the month reads at a glance. Set this week beside the last: pace or speed, and the climb on your runs. Leave a note when a day changes the plan.
Plan the day. Fuel it. Finish it.
text.One connected workflow, before, during a: The course and the doses are ready before you start. On the move, the next stop is in front of you. At the finish, you choose what goes out.
text.Name the plan, set the date, and choose: Set the date, the course and the time you want. Mark it as a race when it is one.
Know what to take, every hour.
text.Turn your profile and the expected condi: Your profile and the conditions you expect become hourly targets for water, carbohydrate and sodium.
See the course before you press Start.
text.Check the predicted time, sections and c: The time Oxygon expects, the sections, and every stop on the climb.
text.Check the fuel totals, calculate fuellin: See what the day adds up to. Change any stop. That edit stays.
text.See elapsed time, distance, sensors, con: Time, distance, your sensors, the next stop. One glance, then back to the effort.
text.Post to Community or share to Strava. Yo: Post it to Community, or send it to Strava. Export opens the web app: you pick the dates, and you can add a training report as a PDF.
Learn the course. Then race it.
text.Verified courses and your own GPX files,: Real routes, and your own GPX, in one place.
Know the course before race day.
text.Browse verified races with their actual: Open a real race: the route, the distance, the climb, the cut-offs. Or start from your own GPX.
text.Start from the complete toolkit, then op: Open any calculator large enough to read. Pace, a prediction from a recent run, zones, grade, calories.
The people who care can see you move.
text.Share one link. Your crew sees your posi: One link. They see where you are, your pace and your heart rate, in a browser. No app for them. No account. They can see it while you are moving.
text.The existing interactive crew experience: The live view your crew gets.
